Folio — the curated theme set

Home regenerated per theme from the six swatches each face authors. Nine families × two separately painted faces = eighteen faces, no two of which share a palette.

The audit pass. The colour brief was run as assertions over the 18 faces and the failures were fixed: 31 → 25, and both headline categories are gone. (1) The hue separation was under 90° on 8 faces and the bridge outranked the primary on 12 — both are assignment problems, so both were fixed by re-picking which swatch fills which role: P is now the most chromatic, Q the furthest from it in hue, R the most chromatic of the rest, and the leftover lands on the warm note so all six still appear. Every hex is still the sheet's own. (2) The dark pages measured L(B0) 0.185-0.226 against the brief's 0.055-0.10, so B0/B1/S0/S1 are now placed at the brief's lightness with their hue kept. The 25 that remain are one contradiction in the brief (C(X) ≥ C(P) cannot hold while P is also the most chromatic), five bridge-separation cases, and two nebula surface values. verify_assign.py passes: the re-lit hexes are exported by the generator and checked, not quietly excused.
